[[Assassin Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for assassins by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Assassin Spiked Guise|Spiked Guise]]
*[[Assassin Bladed Gloves|Bladed Gloves]]
*[[Assassin Oni Leggings|Oni Leggings]]
*[[Assassin Winged Shoes|Winged Shoes]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 350{{hide}}, 15{{Monstrous Claw}}, 10{{leather}}, 10{{Deldrimor Steel}} and 40{{plat}}
